title: Observability: wc_AesInit failure in GCM sess_init emits no log
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm.c:111-113: wc_AesInit failure jumps to err_free_ctx with no pr_err before wolfssl_gcm_xlat_err(ret). This is the only wolfCrypt call in the file that has no log before translation. Every other failure in wolfssl_aes_gcm.c (wc_AesGcmSetKey:117, wc_AesGcmEncryptInit:382, wc_AesGcmEncryptUpdate:391/401, wc_AesGcmEncryptFinal:474, wc_AesGcmDecrypt:513) has a pr_err_ratelimited with __func__ and the raw wc_err. A wc_AesInit failure would be reported to the fd layer as a translated -EIO (or -ENOMEM/-EINVAL) with nothing in the ring buffer identifying the raw wolfCrypt code.
